input: Nowadays, our world is advancing technologically at a rapid pace. Social media is one of the applications of technology that we use for the means of communication. Facebook, YouTube, WhatsApp, Instagram, etc. are the most widely used social media platforms. Besides its contribution to making our day-to-day communication easier, social media has its own negative impact. Heavy social media usage can cause either physical or mental harm to individuals. Frequent users of social media have higher chance to be affected by loneliness, depression, anxiety and even can attempt a suicide. As they prefer to interact with people over the internet than a face-to-face interaction with people around them, they feel unhappy when those peoples are not online or if they are not able to communicate with those peoples. Social media is the easiest tool to send and receive information, whether it's right or wrong. So false information can be distributed over social media which can cause violence and crime. Eventually this can lead to war, poverty and lack of peace. Social media greatly affects our lives as it has the power to influence our thoughts. Generally, we all have to consider the negative impacts of social media, not only it's advantages.
